home.json .hero.heading.en: We build and back companies for the [long view].
home.json .hero.heading.zh: 我们以[长远目光]建立并支持企业。

home.json .hero.lede.en: DF Group partners with founders, corporates, and investors across Asia and beyond — pairing a global advisory network with patient capital and hands-on execution.
home.json .hero.lede.zh: DF Group 与亚洲及各地的创办人、企业与投资者携手合作，结合全球顾问网络、耐心资本与亲身参与的执行力。

home.json .intro.statement.en: Diligent in our research. [Faithful] to the companies we back.
home.json .intro.statement.zh: 研究，[勤勉]；对所支持的企业，忠实。

home.json .practices.lede.en: From first strategy to exit, we operate across the full lifecycle of a business — as advisor, builder, and investor.
home.json .practices.lede.zh: 从最初的策略到最终的退出，我们贯穿企业的完整生命周期——身兼顾问、共建者与投资者。

home.json .practices.items[1].desc.en: We co-found and scale new ventures, supplying operating talent, structure, and capital from the earliest stage.
home.json .practices.items[1].desc.zh: 我们共同创办并扩展新企业，从最早期即投入营运人才、架构与资本。

home.json .practices.items[3].desc.en: Programmes and convenings that connect leaders across our network and sharpen how they lead.
home.json .practices.items[3].desc.zh: 透过课程与聚会连结网络中的领袖，并提升他们的领导能力。

home.json .practices.items[4].desc.en: End-to-end production of the events, panels, and media that build a company’s profile and relationships.
home.json .practices.items[4].desc.zh: 全程统筹各类活动、论坛与媒体项目，建立企业形象与人脉关系。

home.json .approach.statement.en: We create value with our network, our expertise, and [capital that waits].
home.json .approach.statement.zh: 我们以网络、专业，以及[愿意等待的资本]创造价值。

home.json .approach.paragraphs[0].en: Good companies are rarely built in a single quarter. We take the time to understand a business, price it on fundamentals rather than narrative, and support it through the parts of the journey that don’t make headlines.
home.json .approach.paragraphs[0].zh: 优秀的企业鲜少在单一季度内建成。我们愿意花时间了解一盘生意，以基本面而非故事来定价，并在那些不会登上头条的阶段持续支持。

home.json .approach.paragraphs[1].en: That patience is only possible because of who sits around the table — operators, researchers, and specialists who have built and run companies themselves. When we commit, we commit as partners.
home.json .approach.paragraphs[1].zh: 这份耐心源于同坐一桌的人——曾亲自建立并经营企业的营运者、研究员与专才。我们一旦承诺，就以伙伴的身份同行。

home.json .cta.text.en: Whether you’re raising capital, exploring a transaction, or want to join the network, we’d like to hear from you.
home.json .cta.text.zh: 无论您正在募集资金、探索交易机会，或希望加入我们的网络，我们都乐意聆听。

site.json .teamPage.ctaText.en: We’re always in conversation with founders, operators, and co-investors. If your work sits in one of our sectors — or somewhere we should be looking — we’d like to hear from you.

team.json .leadership[0].bio.en: Decades of experience as a banker, investor, and entrepreneur, with senior roles across banks, securities firms, property companies, venture capital, academic associations, and family offices in Europe and Asia. MBA from INSEAD; alumnus of City University of Hong Kong, Peking University, and Warwick Business School.
team.json .leadership[0].bio.zh: 拥有数十年银行家、投资者与企业家经验，曾于欧洲及亚洲的银行、证券公司、地产公司、创投基金、学术组织与家族办公室担任高级职务。INSEAD 工商管理硕士；香港城市大学、北京大学及华威商学院校友。

team.json .leadership[1].bio.en: Over 50 years in the financial industry. Co-established a Hong Kong–listed financial company and a greenfield single family office, and previously held the Chief Executive role at a listed financial company in Hong Kong.
team.json .leadership[1].bio.zh: 逾五十年金融业经验。曾共同创立一家香港上市金融公司及一家全新设立的单一家族办公室，并曾出任香港一家上市金融公司的行政总裁。

team.json .leadership[2].role.zh: 经理 · 市场推广与设计

team.json .leadership[2].bio.en: Trained as an architect and design-school graduate, Andrew leads marketing and design across the group. He also owns galleries and camera shops in Asia.
team.json .leadership[2].bio.zh: 建筑师出身，设计学院毕业，负责集团的市场推广与设计工作，同时在亚洲经营画廊及相机店。

team.json .leadership[3].bio.en: Keeps the team operating efficiently and effectively across regions, coordinating the moving parts behind every mandate.
team.json .leadership[3].bio.zh: 确保团队跨地区高效运作，统筹每项委托背后的各项事务。

team.json .leadership[4].bio.en: Leads the group’s research and investment strategy, translating original analysis into the theses behind our decisions.
team.json .leadership[4].bio.zh: 领导集团的研究与投资策略，将原创分析转化为投资决策背后的论点。

team.json .leadership[5].bio.en: Ensures the group operates to a high compliance standard, managing risk across the firm’s activities.
team.json .leadership[5].bio.zh: 确保集团维持高水平的合规标准，并管理业务营运中的各项风险。

team.json .leadership[6].bio.en: Manages relationships with investors and partners, ensuring the success of our clients from first contact onward.
team.json .leadership[6].bio.zh: 管理与投资者及伙伴的关系，从初次接触起确保客户取得理想成果。

news.json .entries[2].excerpt.en: Kenneth Kwong met leading European business families and, invited by the Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco, attended the Blue Economy & Finance Forum on ocean science and impact investing.

news.json .entries[3].excerpt.en: A series of Singapore events bringing tier-one investors, operators, and founders together across AI, quantum, medtech, climate, fintech, and advanced manufacturing.

news.json .entries[4].excerpt.en: DF Group is proud to be an ecosystem supporter of TEDxHongKong, held at Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks (HKSTP).
news.json .entries[4].excerpt.zh: DF Group 很荣幸成为 TEDxHongKong 的生态伙伴，活动于香港科学园举行。
